decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 3 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the walls of the extensions hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - Prior to any equipment, machinery or materials being broung on to the site, details of the measure to protect, during construction, the root systems of the trees on the adjacent Motorway Enbankment, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and thereafter maintianed until the completion of all construction work. These measures shall include fencing in accordance with British Standard.

Condition : 5 - Before the development is commenced a scheme for protecting the proposed residential extensions from excessive external noise shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and any works which form part of such a scheme shall be completed before any part of the development is first occupied or used.
description: Erection of a 2 storey side and part rear extension, single storey rear extension, rear and side roof extensions to the existing house.
